title: Pondering Pebble Puffer
statement: Hovering calmly beneath warm amber sunbeams and swaying ribbon-kelp, this diminutive pufferfish spends its days puffing delicate jets of water to sort smooth sea glass and dark slate pebbles into tidy spirals. Whenever a drifting bubble disturbs its geometry, it pauses with wide, luminous eyes before cheerfully beginning the arrangement anew.
